needed.suggestion: Construct a proper footway on the right side of the road to provide a safe path for pedestrians.
Clear the footway on the right side to ensure it is fully usable for pedestrians.
Install a pedestrian refuge island in the middle of the road to provide a safe area for pedestrians to wait when crossing a wide rural road.
Install dropped kerbs at the marked pedestrian crossing on the right side to assist wheelchair users and mobility scooter riders.
